methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched from official vendor pages using WebFetch on 2026-06-14. ZeroBounce's pricing page renders via JavaScript and returned no dollar figures in static HTML across multiple URL variants; pricing sourced from two independent 2026 comparison articles (mailtrap.io blog and saleshandy.com blog), corroborated where possible. NeverBounce returned HTTP 403 on all direct page attempts; rate corroborated by two independent comparison pages (saleshandy.com and clearout.io comparison table). Kickbox.com blocked all WebFetch attempts (connection refused or fetch-blocked); per-1K rate sourced from two independent comparison pages (clearout.io and saleshandy.com). Hunter.io, Bouncer (usebouncer.com), EmailListVerify, Mailfloss, and MailerCheck pricing fetched directly from official pages with full plan data. Emailable pricing page uses a client-side calculator; per-credit rates and PAYG package price sourced from saleshandy.com comparison. billingModel is 'custom' for pure usage-metered PAYG products with no flat recurring tier; 'flat' for fixed monthly subscriptions. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on all plans (non-telephony vertical). monthlyUsd for annually-billed plans is the annualized monthly equivalent; month-to-month rate noted where published.
